## Verdict: PASS

Q151 is FIXED and PINNED: `--fallback` on `tier:nightly` and `tier:milestone` exits 64 with its line verbatim before
anything is read or run, and `tier:pr` keeps the switch; each per-tier pin is red under the mutant aimed at it. Every
gate is green. Lawful-input refusals 0 → 0. The check found no blocker; three new notes (N-12 – N-14) are M4
hardening or equivalence notes.
